Spoke Shop Monday Road Ride

Billings, MT · West End · Road

Beginner friendly

Spoke Shop Monday Road Ride is a road group ride in Billings, MT. It rolls every Monday at 6:30 pm from The Spoke Shop parking lot. Pace: all levels, adjusted to the group.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all levels, adjusted to the group.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Spoke Shop Monday Road Ride group ride

Monday evening road ride from the Spoke Shop lot on Broadwater. Billings TrailNet lists it as open to all levels and adjustable to who shows up. The shop also lists a Saturday morning urban ride (12 to 16 miles) and a Wednesday mountain bike ride from Zimmerman Trail, April to early October. Confirm on the shop's Facebook page before you go.
